title: Cache out of memory after Redis upgrade
alert: Product pages load but the 'Add to cart' button spins and eventually shows 'Service unavailable'. The API health endpoint still returns 200.

truth.root_cause: Redis 7.4 introduced a memory fragmentation issue with the shop's key access pattern. Over the past 9 days memory use has crept up until it hits the 256 MB container limit, where the OOM killer terminates the process. The container restarts but quickly reaches the limit again.
truth.fix: Roll back cache to redis:7.2 (or raise its memory limit to 512 MB), then verify 'Add to cart' works. Long term: upgrade Redis after testing the workload or tune maxmemory-policy.
